The implementation is complete and verified. Here is my report.

## Result
- Goal/task: G-20260731T031357585622Z-8d094bd1 / T-20260731T031357587095Z-2cb11839
- Role: Implementer (Claude Code)
- Status: **ready** (implementation complete; one downstream blocker surfaced for the end-to-end goal — see Next action)

## What changed or decided
Gave the CCA Guardian signal the ADR 0017 bookkeeping-closeout exemption by importing the **one** classifier, never a second copy of the six conditions.

- **`scripts/guardian_approval_signal.py`** — imports `is_bookkeeping_closeout` (and `parse_changed_files_status`) from `mergegate_check`. New helper `_bookkeeping_closeout_exemption` delegates the whole decision to that classifier over three new **optional, default-to-no-exemption** args (`--base-shiki`, `--changed-files-status`, `--merged-prs`). A proven closeout resolves `effective_risk="low"` exactly as MergeGate's `_guardian_risk_labels` does; PR labels can still escalate; every emitted signal records `bookkeeping_closeout_exemption`. Fails closed on every axis (no task id, unreadable task, missing base snapshot, missing changed-files status, unresolvable/unmerged impl PR).
- **`.github/workflows/shiki-cca-completion.yml`** — the `cca` job's *Prepare CCA context* step now builds the base `.shiki` snapshot (`git archive`, **reusing the existing base fetch** — no second fetch, so `test_cca_head_sha_injection`'s count-of-2 assertion holds), reuses the changed-files-status file it already writes, and resolves the merge proof from the **BASE** task's `expected_pr` (never the head's) via `gh pr view --json state`. All three are passed to the signal.
- **`tests/test_guardian_signal_closeout.py`** (new, 17 tests) — proven critical closeout → `required=false`; each disqualifier in isolation and each missing input → `required=true`; the audit flag is recorded; and a parity matrix asserting the signal's exemption decision equals MergeGate's and **is never more permissive**.

## Next action
**Load-bearing follow-up (out of this task's scope/acceptance, flagged so it isn't silently repeated):** the required **"MergeGate policy check"** job in the same workflow (`needs: cca`) computes its own `--merged-prs` **only** under the `<!-- shiki:post_merge_reconcile -->` marker. Before this task that job was *skipped* (CCA failed `needs_guardian`), masking the gap; now that the signal makes CCA `complete`, that job runs and a normal high/critical closeout gets `--merged-prs ""` → `is_bookkeeping_closeout` returns False → it **still blocks on guardian**. To let a closeout merge with zero Guardian approvals end-to-end, that job's *Enforce MergeGate* step needs the same ungated merge-proof resolution (safe: `--merged-prs` is only consumed by `post_merge_reconcile` and the closeout classifier, both independently validating; a normal impl PR's base `expected_pr` points at its own open PR → stays `""`). I did not make this change because the task's stated scope and every acceptance check are signal-only, and its "exact change" names only the signal path. Recommend a sibling/follow-up task for the policy-check job. (Recorded in memory `adr0017-bookkeeping-closeout-exemption`.)
